details.label: Habitat
details.value: Arctic, Coastal, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: The druid is a 4th-level Wisdom spellcaster (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). Cantrips: Druidcraft, Produce Flame, Shillelagh. 1st level (4 slots): Entangle, Longstrider, Speak with Animals, Thunderwave. 2nd level (3 slots): Animal Messenger, Barkskin.

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, or +4 with Shillelagh; reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) when wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) while using Shillelagh.
